title: UAT finding
description: One observation from one persona session. Appended as a line to uat/runs/<run-id>/feedback.jsonl. The enhancement loop reads these, so every field that a triager needs to act without replaying the session is required.

finding_id.description: Stable kebab-case slug, unique within the run. Used to dedupe across runs, so phrase it after the problem, not the session: 'portfolio-total-hides-partial-pricing', not 'day-2-issue-3'.

observed_at.description: Wall-clock time the finding was recorded, not the simulated session date.

session_date.description: Simulated trading date the session represents.

surface.description: Where it was hit. 'data' is for a value that is wrong or unusable regardless of how it is rendered; 'workflow' is for a sequence that is only painful end-to-end.

title.description: One line, states the problem, no rationale clause.

observed.description: What actually happened. Concrete: the value seen, the label read, the time waited.

expected.description: What the persona expected instead, and on what professional basis.

why_it_matters.description: The decision this affected. A finding with no downstream consequence is polish at best.

repro.description: Ordered steps sufficient for an engineer who has never seen the session.

evidence.description: Relative paths to screenshots, response captures, or log excerpts within the run directory.

blocked_decision.description: True when the persona could not place, size or exit a position because of this.

suggested_fix.description: Optional. The persona is a user, not an engineer; a suggestion here is a hint, never a specification.

verification.description: Filled in by the synthesis pass, not by the persona. A persona's claim is a report until someone reads the code.

checked_against.description: Source locations read while verifying, as path:line.
